title: От Матфея 3 — Matthew 3
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.translation: A voice is calling in the wilderness.
cases.explain: Голос is the subject of раздаётся (resounds) → nominative.

cases.sentence: Уже и топор лежит у ___ деревьев.
cases.translation: Even now the axe lies at the root of the trees.
cases.explain: у + genitive: у корня (at the root of).

cases.sentence: К нему приходил народ из Иерусалима, со всей Иудеи и из окрестностей ___.
cases.translation: People came to him from Jerusalem, all Judea, and the region around the Jordan.
cases.explain: окрестности (чего) — genitive shows whose vicinity: окрестности Иордана.

cases.sentence: Приготовьте путь ___, сделайте прямыми дороги его.
cases.translation: Prepare the way for the Lord, make his paths straight.
cases.explain: приготовить (что) кому — dative marks the beneficiary: путь Господу.

cases.sentence: Всякое дерево, не приносящее хорошего плода, будет срублено и брошено в ___.
cases.translation: Every tree that does not bear good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
cases.explain: в + accusative for motion 'into': брошено в огонь (thrown into the fire).

cases.sentence: Он будет крестить вас святым ___ и огнем.
cases.translation: He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
cases.explain: крестить кого чем — instrumental marks the means: святым Духом (with the Holy Spirit).

cases.sentence: Иоанн Креститель начал проповедовать в Иудейской ___.
cases.translation: John the Baptist began preaching in the wilderness of Judea.
cases.explain: в + prepositional for location: в пустыне (in the wilderness).

reading.ru: В те дни Иоанн Креститель начал проповедовать в Иудейской пустыне.
reading.question: Where did John the Baptist begin preaching?
reading.explain: John the Baptist began preaching in the wilderness of Judea.

reading.ru: Иоанн носил одежду из верблюжьей шерсти и подпоясывался кожаным поясом.
reading.question: What did John the Baptist wear, according to the text?
options: Clothing of camel's hair with a leather belt
reading.correct: Clothing of camel's hair with a leather belt
reading.explain: John wore clothing made of camel's hair with a leather belt around his waist.

reading.ru: Я крещу вас водой, но после меня придет тот, кто могущественнее меня.
reading.question: What does John say about the one coming after him?
options: He will be a Roman soldier
He will replace Herod as king
He will build a new temple
reading.explain: John says the one coming after him is mightier than he is.

reading.ru: И вот голос небес, говорящий, «Это мой любимый сын, в нем моя радость».
reading.question: What does the voice from heaven say about Jesus after his baptism?
options: 'This is my beloved Son, in whom I delight'
'This is the King of the Jews'
'This is the Messiah promised by Isaiah'
'This is the light of the world'
reading.correct: 'This is my beloved Son, in whom I delight'
reading.explain: After Jesus is baptized, a voice from heaven calls him the beloved Son.
